productName: Lorena Canals Woolable Sheep of the World Dunes Washable Area Rug
description: Luxurious softness and dramatic eye-catching texture await with the Dunes area rug from Lorena Canals. This piece is part of the Sheep of the World collection, a series that celebrates the natural hues of undyed wool in all of their unique variations. Dunes is a machine-washable wool rug made possible using patented Woolable rug technology. Choose from two neutral colorways featuring ridged pile texture.
